title: Feature #201 contract — shape of the knip.json produced by this feature
description: This schema is NOT a full knip-configuration schema. It constrains only the subset this feature is authorised to produce, enforcing FR-004/FR-005/FR-008 (minimum scope, no broader silencing). Any future feature that legitimately expands the config (e.g., adding another workspace) will relax this schema by opening a new feature with its own Constitution Check.

$schema.description: Pointer to knip's published JSON Schema. MUST pin major version 5.

workspaces.description: Map keyed by workspace path. This feature is only permitted to add the 'apps/loader' key.

entry.description: Source paths (relative to apps/loader) that knip treats as reachable roots.

anyOf.description: Rejected: 'ignore' patterns would violate FR-004/FR-008 — silencing broader than reachability is prohibited.
Rejected: unrelated to the loader false-positive problem; violates FR-005.
